priority_rules: Immediate evacuation: latest movement is at least 10 mm/h, movement more than doubles across the three-hour series, soil saturation is at least 90 percent, and 24-hour rainfall is at least 160 mm.
Evacuation preparation: latest movement is at least 5 mm/h with soil saturation at least 85 percent, or a critical access constraint compounds an active movement trend.
Enhanced monitoring: movement is below 5 mm/h but increasing, or soil saturation is at least 80 percent.
Routine monitoring: none of the higher criteria are met.
ranking_rules: Rank measured ground acceleration, saturation, rainfall, exposure, and access constraints before contextual characteristics.
Within a tier, rank the zone with the faster movement trend and more constrained evacuation access first.
Building age describes exposure context and does not establish present slope instability.
operational_boundary: This indexed evidence supports municipal emergency review and does not itself send public alerts or confirm field evacuation.
